description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Amended by the Gaz.Ex.No. 2043/13 dated 30.10.2017 that Delegation of Powers by the Public Service Commission
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission regarding the appointment, promotion, transfer, and disciplinary control of public officers (specifically teachers). The content is focused on public sector administration, service conditions, and the authority of a public service body, which aligns with the definition of a Public Service Gazette.
